release_notes: Quieter Ready Messages log. The previous-incoming Ready (the line just above the newest) no longer renders in a 12pt bold middle-tier font -- it now uses the same 10pt normal weight as the older lines, keeping only the theme's dark accent color so it still reads as 'still recent.' Rationale: the 1.0.61-1.0.65 layout work (center-aligned bodies, gray separators between entries, timestamps in a neat right-aligned column) already gives each entry plenty of visual structure; the middle-tier font weight was overkill on top of that and made the log feel stair-stepped. Only the newest Ready (15pt bold) is now visually loud, which matches what the user actually needs to glance at. The row-padding math that equalizes per-line heights across tiers was updated alongside the font change so recent2 lines no longer compute padding against a 12pt-bold target they no longer use -- vertical rhythm between adjacent lines stays even.
